name: Exposed database credentials
evidence: Embedded SQLite in the user profile; no DB server or credentials exist. Pattern scan of all git history: 0 credential hits.

name: Public .env files
evidence: No .env/credential/key files ever committed (git log --all --name-only); nothing is web-hosted.

name: Hardcoded API keys or secrets
evidence: AWS/GitHub/OpenAI/Slack/Google/private-key/password patterns: 0 real hits; 1 false positive is the MVNW_PASSWORD variable reference in the Maven wrapper.
verification: Redacted pattern scan of working tree and history

name: Weak or missing authentication
evidence: IdleStow is a single-user local desktop app with no accounts, servers, network endpoints or browser UI; the OS user account is the boundary.

name: Missing server-side authorization
evidence: Trusted boundary is core: Authorizer re-reads folder authorization and protections before every mutation; UI cannot mutate files directly (final review grep of app/).

name: Cross-user data access
evidence: IdleStow is a single-user local desktop app with no accounts, servers, network endpoints or browser UI.

name: Open database permissions
evidence: SQLite file under %LOCALAPPDATA%\IdleStow inherits the per-user profile ACL; the app opens no network ports or listeners.
verification: Code review (no ServerSocket/HTTP server in product code)

name: Misconfigured Firebase / Supabase / S3
evidence: No cloud databases or object storage are used.

name: Unprotected admin routes
evidence: IdleStow is a single-user local desktop app with no accounts, servers, network endpoints or browser UI; no admin interface.

name: Production debug tools exposed
evidence: Only local CLI flags --smoke-test/--self-test exist; self-test refuses roots, the home folder and non-empty folders and deletes only what it created.
fix: Self-test deletion bug found in final review was fixed
verification: SelfTestSafetyTest (3); packaged run on a non-empty folder left the canary intact

name: Build logs leaking secrets
evidence: CI workflows use no secrets, print no credentials, permissions: contents: read.

name: Verbose production errors
evidence: Errors are shown only to the local user who ran the action; there are no remote clients to leak internals to.

name: Secrets in Git history
evidence: All 5 commits on all refs scanned without printing values: no secrets found.

name: Secrets shipped in frontend JavaScript
evidence: No JavaScript; the shipped desktop image (dist/windows/IdleStow) contains no credentials, keys, .env or databases.
verification: Inspection of packaged image file list

name: Client-side-only security checks
evidence: All eligibility/authorization rules are enforced in core (preview re-evaluated at execute, preflight before mutation), not only in the UI.

name: Missing input validation
evidence: IPC messages strictly validated and size-bounded; settings range-validated; GLOB exclusions validated; archive member names validated.
fix: GLOB validation added after unit-test review

name: SQL injection
evidence: All SQL is parameterized; dynamic ORDER BY comes only from enums; LIKE wildcards escaped.

name: NoSQL injection
evidence: No NoSQL store is used.

name: Cross-site scripting (XSS)
evidence: No web pages or WebView; JavaFX controls render plain text.

name: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF)
evidence: IdleStow is a single-user local desktop app with no accounts, servers, network endpoints or browser UI.

name: Insecure file uploads
evidence: No uploads; locally processed archives are covered under check 22.

name: Path traversal
evidence: Roots canonicalized (toRealPath); link/junction components rejected; archive extraction writes only to a fixed destination with member allow-list (ZIP-slip impossible); exclusive creation, no overwrite.
fix: No-replace renames added after security review
verification: AuthorizerTest; python test_archive.py (ZIP-slip, absolute, .., symlink members); SecurityRegressionTest.safeMoveNeverOverwrites

name: Server-side request forgery (SSRF)
evidence: Product code performs no network requests (no HTTP/socket clients found).

evidence: No passwords or accounts.

name: Weak session management
evidence: No sessions.

evidence: No tokens.

name: Overly permissive CORS
evidence: No HTTP server.

evidence: No network endpoints; local resource ceilings are covered by check 64.

evidence: No hosted environments; tests use synthetic data in temporary folders only.

evidence: No accounts, example users or default passwords exist anywhere in the code.

evidence: No webhooks.

evidence: IdleStow is a single-user local desktop app with no accounts, servers, network endpoints or browser UI.

evidence: No APIs or roles.

name: Sensitive source maps or build artifacts
evidence: Packaged image contains only launchers, app jars, runtime, worker, LICENSE/NOTICE/README; no .db/.log/.pdb/.map/test files; build caches are git-ignored.

name: Malicious or compromised packages
evidence: Dependencies from Maven Central/PyPI with exact versions; bundled Temurin JDK, CPython embeddable, zstandard wheel and Maven distribution verified by SHA-256 against publisher checksums.

name: Prompt injection
evidence: The product contains no AI/LLM features.

name: AI tools bypassing user permissions
evidence: The product contains no AI/LLM features.

name: Excess database privileges
evidence: Single embedded database file used by one local process; no database roles exist.

name: Missing audit logs
evidence: Every operation is recorded in optimization_history and operation_journal (action, origin, mode, before/after, verification, outcome) without file contents.

name: No security monitoring or alerts
evidence: IdleStow is a single-user local desktop app with no accounts, servers, network endpoints or browser UI; locally, failed jobs and recovery issues raise notifications and block autonomous work.

name: No tested backup / restore plan
evidence: Recovery manifests outside the DB plus manifests inside each archive; documented emergency procedure.

name: Public internal dashboards
evidence: No hosted dashboards.

name: Missing security headers
evidence: No HTTP responses are served.

name: Unsafe cookie settings
evidence: No cookies.

name: Sensitive data unprotected in transit / at rest
evidence: No data is transmitted. At rest, the index (paths, metadata) is stored unencrypted in the user profile, protected by OS file permissions; no credentials are stored.

name: Poor tenant isolation
evidence: IdleStow is a single-user local desktop app with no accounts, servers, network endpoints or browser UI.

name: Over-trusting AI-generated code
evidence: Two independent code reviews with fixes and 590+ automated tests exist, but a recorded line-by-line maintainer review of core/jobs, the Authorizer and the Windows adapter is not evidenced.
fix: Maintainer should review safety-critical modules before 1.0

name: Mass assignment / over-posting
evidence: Settings.with rejects unknown keys and all values are re-validated; IPC ignores unknown params; recovery-record paths validated before deletion.
fix: Record path validation added after security review

name: Command / OS injection
evidence: Only ProcessBuilder argument lists (Python worker); no shell; Windows Run-key command quoting rejects quotes/control characters.

name: Unsafe deserialization
evidence: Jackson parses into maps/JsonNode only (no default typing); Python uses json; no Java serialization; logback deserialization advisories removed by upgrade.

name: Misconfigured OAuth / OIDC / social login
evidence: No login.

name: No MFA on privileged accounts
evidence: The GitHub account MaDaAi controls the source and releases; 2FA status cannot be verified from here.
fix: Owner: confirm GitHub two-factor authentication is enabled

name: Account enumeration
evidence: No accounts.

name: Business-logic abuse
evidence: Approvals are bound to a plan digest, single-use, expiring; autonomy requires a confirmed policy digest; state transitions are journaled.
fix: Approval re-arming removed after security review

name: Race conditions
evidence: Per-file and per-recovery-record locks, single-instance lock, SQLite transactions, identity re-check on the NTFS handle, no-replace renames.
fix: Per-record lock added (was known issue KI-3)

name: Webhook replay / duplicate processing
evidence: No webhooks.

name: Overpowered CI/CD credentials
evidence: Workflows declare permissions: contents: read, use no secrets or deploy tokens; packaging only uploads build artifacts.

name: Untrusted build actions or scripts
evidence: Only official actions/* are used; build scripts reviewed; no curl-pipe-shell.

evidence: GitHub Actions were pinned by movable tags and CI tools were unpinned.
